paper.title: ResMimic: From General Motion Tracking to Humanoid Whole-body Loco-Manipulation via Residual Learning
paper.source_version: arXiv v2, 2025-10-08; official code supplement pinned at fa20d98dbbf9b5b903db20435d90a4964bcf09d9

decision_relevance.why_admitted: It defines synchronized robot-object-contact references and executable object/contact reward forms, then exposes the confounding changes that must be excluded from a fixed-trainer harness experiment.
not_evidence_for: A causal benefit from the point-cloud reward alone
A causal benefit from the contact reward alone
An OGMP state machine or learned oracle
A fixed-MDP comparison, because residual inputs, policy architecture, virtual forces, and termination also change

mechanisms.name: Two-stage GMT plus residual policy
mechanisms.description: A pretrained GMT policy emits a coarse joint target and a per-task PPO policy emits a 29-D correction; the actions are added before the PD controller.

mechanisms.name: Synchronized robot-object reference
mechanisms.description: Human motion is retargeted to the robot while recorded object motion is retained, producing time-aligned robot and object trajectories for residual training.

mechanisms.name: Point-cloud object tracking reward
mechanisms.description: Corresponding object-surface points jointly encode translation and rotation error in an exponential tracking reward.

mechanisms.name: Reference-gated contact reward
mechanisms.description: Per-link reference contacts are inferred from link-to-object distance and gate exponential functions of simulated contact force; feet are excluded.

mechanisms.name: Virtual object force curriculum
mechanisms.description: Training-only PD forces and torques track the reference object and are gradually decayed so the learned policy takes over.

mechanisms.name: Reference-aware early termination
mechanisms.description: Episodes end for excessive object-reference mesh deviation or loss of any required reference contact for more than ten consecutive frames.

failure_modes.name: Retargeting contact defects
failure_modes.description: Penetration or floating contact can make the base behavior knock over the object, yielding early termination and a retreating local optimum.

failure_modes.name: Heavy-object early-training instability
failure_modes.description: Large object masses destabilize early learning; the proposed workaround applies training-only forces and therefore changes the dynamics seen during optimization.

failure_modes.name: Under-specified reward and curriculum parameters
failure_modes.description: The paper leaves N, lambda_o, sigma_c, contact lambda, sigma_o, PD gains and decay, PPO settings, success threshold, rollout count, and seeds unspecified; the code snapshot fills only part of this gap.

failure_modes.name: Bundled intervention confound
failure_modes.description: Residual architecture, object observations, reward terms, virtual assistance, and termination differ together, so reported gains do not isolate Sam's reference or reward knob.

failure_modes.name: Qualitative real-world evidence
failure_modes.description: The paper demonstrates payloads and behaviors but gives no real-world aggregate success rate; the 11-trial figure does not report outcomes.

evaluation.name: Four-task IsaacGym-to-MuJoCo evaluation
evaluation.description: Policies trained in IsaacGym are evaluated in MuJoCo on Kneel, Carry, Squat, and Chair against GMT-only, scratch, and fine-tune baselines.

evaluation.name: Independent tracking and success metrics
evaluation.description: Reported metrics are training iterations, object point error, global-link motion error, joint error, and task success defined by object error plus balance.

evaluation.name: Qualitative curriculum and contact ablations
evaluation.description: Figures show behavioral differences with the virtual controller and contact reward, but no numeric factorial effects are reported.

evaluation.name: Unitree G1 real-world demonstrations
evaluation.description: Blind and MoCap-assisted demonstrations cover box/chair interactions, payloads through 5.5 kg, consecutive tasks, random initial poses, and perturbations.

evidence.claim: GMT produces a coarse action, a per-task PPO residual policy produces a correction, and the two actions are added.
AMASS and OMOMO together provide more than 15,000 clips and approximately 42 hours before/after the described curation.
The paper specifies t-10:t proprioception, t-10:t+10 robot/object reference windows, and a 29-dimensional residual action.
Simultaneous human-object MoCap is converted into paired retargeted robot and object reference trajectories.

evidence.locator: Section III-C2, Network Initialization and Virtual Object Force Curriculum; Figure 4
evidence.claim: The residual actor starts near zero; training-only object PD forces address reference defects and heavy-object instability; Figure 4 identifies 11 random-pose trials without an aggregate outcome.

evidence.locator: Section III-C3, Reward and Early Termination
evidence.claim: The paper defines point-cloud object and reference-contact rewards plus object-deviation and lost-contact termination conditions, while leaving their numeric symbols unspecified except the ten-frame contact rule.
Across four MuJoCo tasks, mean success is 92.5% for ResMimic, 10% for GMT-only, 0% for scratch, and 7.5% for fine-tuning.
The evaluation defines four tasks and reports training iterations, object error, motion error, joint error, and success rate; exact success threshold and rollout count are not supplied.
The virtual object controller and contact reward are supported by qualitative ablation figures and narrative rather than numeric factorial results.
Real-world demonstrations include a 4.5 kg box and 4.5/5.5 kg chairs, but no aggregate real-world success rate is reported.
The official example samples 1,024 centered surface points with seed 2024.
The official example sets object-far threshold 0.3, point-cloud reward weight 2.0, and residual final-layer gain 0.01.
The official runner adds residual and base actions before the environment step.
The official example computes mean corresponding-point distance and applies an exp(-10 * distance) reward kernel.
